speech_units.text: Good supper. Now the promises. Each card goes to the person named on it.
speech_units.caption_text: Good supper. Now the promises. Each card goes to the person named on it.

speech_units.text: I was hoping the food might speak for itself.
speech_units.caption_text: I was hoping the food might speak for itself.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: It did. It made no offer to wash up.
speech_units.caption_text: It did. It made no offer to wash up.

speech_units.caption_text: My card is cooking and cleanup. This one belongs to the name at the top.

speech_units.speaker: Bunny Easter
speech_units.text: Accurate invitations and the agreed guest count. I’ll invite them to the evening we’re actually having. How novel.

speech_units.text: Invitations and guest count. That’s mine. I know everybody; it doesn’t mean I’ve offered to do everything.
speech_units.caption_text: Invitations and guest count. That’s mine. I know everybody; it doesn’t mean I’ve offered to do everything.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: The shared plan and written terms. I’ll write down the jobs. “But it’s in your handwriting” will not make it my washing-up.
speech_units.caption_text: The shared plan and written terms. I’ll write down the jobs. “But it’s in your handwriting” will not make it my washing-up.

speech_units.text: The shared plan and written terms are mine. This card belongs to the name at the top.
speech_units.caption_text: The shared plan and written terms are mine. This card belongs to the name at the top.

speech_units.speaker: Milo Pennant
speech_units.text: My sound equipment, at the agreed volume. Good lord. I’ve finished talking and I’m still here.
speech_units.caption_text: My sound equipment, at the agreed volume. Good lord. I’ve finished talking and I’m still here.

speech_units.text: Sound equipment and the agreed volume. That’s my card. I’m trying to make a smaller promise; don’t distract me.
speech_units.caption_text: Sound equipment and the agreed volume. That’s my card. I’m trying to make a smaller promise; don’t distract me.

speech_units.speaker: Vivian Voss
speech_units.text: Tonight’s styling, and a later conversation. No guaranteed booking. There. Even my small print looks good.
speech_units.caption_text: Tonight’s styling, and a later conversation. No guaranteed booking. There. Even my small print looks good.

speech_units.speaker: Vivian Voss
speech_units.text: Tonight’s styling, then a conversation about possible work. No booking promised. I’m not available by the paragraph.
speech_units.caption_text: Tonight’s styling, then a conversation about possible work. No booking promised. I’m not available by the paragraph.

speech_units.speaker: Rita Stringer
speech_units.text: My ceramic service and display, credited to Rita Stringer. That’s mine. I’ve practised the modest little nod.
speech_units.caption_text: My ceramic service and display, credited to Rita Stringer. That’s mine. I’ve practised the modest little nod.

speech_units.text: Ceramic service and display. Rita Stringer. My name’s on the plates; there’s no need to look at my husband.
speech_units.caption_text: Ceramic service and display. Rita Stringer. My name’s on the plates; there’s no need to look at my husband.

speech_units.speaker: Felix Bunt
speech_units.text: The tested gate and the agreed scheduled repair work. I’d make a speech, but you’ve seen the gate.
speech_units.caption_text: The tested gate and the agreed scheduled repair work. I’d make a speech, but you’ve seen the gate.

speech_units.speaker: Felix Bunt
speech_units.text: The tested gate and the scheduled repair work. Those are my jobs. I’m wearing a tool belt, not a chain of office.
speech_units.caption_text: The tested gate and the scheduled repair work. Those are my jobs. I’m wearing a tool belt, not a chain of office.

speech_units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
speech_units.text: Renewal, and I fund and schedule the agreed repair. Yes, both. Frankie is looking at the gap after “and.”
speech_units.caption_text: Renewal, and I fund and schedule the agreed repair. Yes, both. Frankie is looking at the gap after “and.”

laugh_opportunity.runtime_policy: Existing separately authorized speech/laugh presentation policy; never alter puzzle state. Suppress on quiet repeats, boundaries, apparent injury or sincere follow-up.

speech_units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
speech_units.text: Renewal, repair funding and scheduling. That’s my card. I can express a view on the cooking, but apparently that isn’t a contribution.
speech_units.caption_text: Renewal, repair funding and scheduling. That’s my card. I can express a view on the cooking, but apparently that isn’t a contribution.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: Approved, and pinned under the right name. No one has accidentally acquired a spouse.
speech_units.caption_text: Approved, and pinned under the right name. No one has accidentally acquired a spouse.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: Ask the person named on it first. Being legible isn’t the same as agreeing.
speech_units.caption_text: Ask the person named on it first. Being legible isn’t the same as agreeing.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: I thought keeping everyone happy meant saying yes to everything. Thank you for helping me do the things I actually promised. To our home, and everyone who helped us make room.
speech_units.caption_text: I thought keeping everyone happy meant saying yes to everything. Thank you for helping me do the things I actually promised. To our home, and everyone who helped us make room.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: To eight people who came for three different evenings and stayed for the same one. Thank you. Next time I’ll ask you before saying you’d be delighted.
speech_units.caption_text: To eight people who came for three different evenings and stayed for the same one. Thank you. Next time I’ll ask you before saying you’d be delighted.

laugh_opportunity.runtime_policy: Existing separately authorized speech/laugh presentation policy; never alter puzzle state. Suppress on quiet repeats, boundaries, apparent injury or sincere follow-up.

speech_units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
speech_units.text: Care for the house. The agreed guests and noise. Renewal confirmed, and the promised repair funded and scheduled.
speech_units.caption_text: Care for the house. The agreed guests and noise. Renewal confirmed, and the promised repair funded and scheduled.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: Those are the standards for the household. Our private relationships are our own.
speech_units.caption_text: Those are the standards for the household. Our private relationships are our own.

speech_units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
speech_units.text: Yes. I’ll judge how you look after the place.
speech_units.caption_text: Yes. I’ll judge how you look after the place.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: Good. No box for “who’s kissing whom.” I checked.
speech_units.caption_text: Good. No box for “who’s kissing whom.” I checked.

speech_units.speaker: Mr. Stringer
speech_units.text: I gathered.
speech_units.caption_text: I gathered.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: It needs his agreement and his signature. We’ve spent the evening getting the words right. I’m not borrowing his name now.
speech_units.caption_text: It needs his agreement and his signature. We’ve spent the evening getting the words right. I’m not borrowing his name now.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: Signed and pinned. Renewal, and the agreed repair. I can stop wondering what his smile means.
speech_units.caption_text: Signed and pinned. Renewal, and the agreed repair. I can stop wondering what his smile means.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: I’ll add the repair date we agreed. Then I’m reading the whole card back. We’re leaving nothing cropped.
speech_units.caption_text: I’ll add the repair date we agreed. Then I’m reading the whole card back. We’re leaving nothing cropped.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: Renewal commitment confirmed. The agreed repair is funded and scheduled for {repair_date}. We care for the house and keep the agreed guest and noise arrangements. Everyone has heard the whole agreement.
speech_units.caption_text: Renewal commitment confirmed. The agreed repair is funded and scheduled for {repair_date}. We care for the house and keep the agreed guest and noise arrangements. Everyone has heard the whole agreement.

dynamic_bindings.repair_date: The date selected on the existing in-fiction repair card; not a real calendar event.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: There. Your pencil. Our copy. Keep both.
speech_units.caption_text: There. Your pencil. Our copy. Keep both.

speech_units.speaker: Vivian Voss
speech_units.text: We’ll talk about possible work another day. Tonight you delivered the supper. I’ve met producers who couldn’t manage lunch.
speech_units.caption_text: We’ll talk about possible work another day. Tonight you delivered the supper. I’ve met producers who couldn’t manage lunch.

speech_units.speaker: Vivian Voss
speech_units.text: Another conversation, another day. I’d like to see what you’re like when you aren’t preventing three things from falling over.
speech_units.caption_text: Another conversation, another day. I’d like to see what you’re like when you aren’t preventing three things from falling over.

speech_units.speaker: Vivian Voss
speech_units.text: I’d like that other conversation. We can decide what to call it when you aren’t holding a tray between us.
speech_units.caption_text: I’d like that other conversation. We can decide what to call it when you aren’t holding a tray between us.

speech_units.speaker: Bunny Easter
speech_units.text: Rita got the house right.
speech_units.caption_text: Rita got the house right.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: Our doors aren’t those colors.
speech_units.caption_text: Our doors aren’t those colors.

speech_units.speaker: Bunny Easter
speech_units.text: Not the doors. Us.
speech_units.caption_text: Not the doors. Us.

speech_units.speaker: Frankie Maplewood
speech_units.text: There’s enough room at the table.
speech_units.caption_text: There’s enough room at the table.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: There is.
speech_units.caption_text: There is.

speech_units.speaker: Milo Pennant
speech_units.text: Mutual Benefit Supper. I’ve kept it very simple.
speech_units.caption_text: Mutual Benefit Supper. I’ve kept it very simple.

speech_units.speaker: Jackie Tree
speech_units.text: Put “It’s a meal” underneath. In very large letters.
speech_units.caption_text: Put “It’s a meal” underneath. In very large letters.
